name: The Crimson Abbot

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 553). Spell save DC 15 is the book's; +7 to hit with spells is computed (Charisma +4, proficiency +3). Crimson Clergy is another stat block of the same appendix.

traits.name: Honor Lost
traits.summary: A Bonus Action memento or reminder of his past plus a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check gives him Disadvantage on his next D20 Test before that creature's next turn starts.
traits.text: A creature that spends a Bonus Action presenting a memento or reciting a reminder of who the abbot used to be, and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check, gives the abbot Disadvantage on the next D20 Test he makes before the start of that creature's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.summary: Three times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the abbot fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 3 times a day.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The abbot can climb difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.summary: Takes 20 Radiant damage starting a turn in sunlight; Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in it.
traits.text: The abbot takes 20 Radiant damage if he starts his turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of his lair: spilled blood stays fresh for a day, and an enemy of the abbot who takes Fire damage starts burning until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: Regional effects, within 1 mile of the blood-soaked monastery while the abbot lives and keeps his lair there. Fresh Blood: spilled blood doesn't dry or clot and stays fresh for 24 hours. Incinerate Heresy: when an enemy of the abbot takes Fire damage it starts burning until the end of its next turn. Both end the moment he dies or moves his lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Sanguine Blades; one can be a Blood Call.

actions.name: Blood Call

params.when: a Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this damage, once buried, at the next sunset

actions.summary: One creature within 30 ft (not a Construct or Undead): DC 15 Con save or 2d6 Necrotic, its Hit Point maximum drops by that much and he heals the same; half damage on a success (he heals on a success too).
actions.text: He calls the blood out of someone within 30 feet who is neither a Construct nor Undead. DC 15 Constitution save: on a failure 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage and the target's Hit Point maximum falls by the damage; on a success half damage and no maximum loss. Either way the abbot regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. A Humanoid brought to 0 Hit Points by it and then buried rises at the next sunset as a Crimson Clergy under his control.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Charisma, DC 15: Command, Disguise Self and Thaumaturgy at will; Word of Recall (to his lair only) once a day.
actions.text: The abbot casts one of these, needing no Material components (Charisma, spell save DC 15). At will: Command, Disguise Self (a Medium Humanoid, lasting 24 hours), Thaumaturgy. 1/day: Word of Recall, to his lair only.

actions.name: Castigate
actions.summary: Legendary only. One creature within 60 ft: DC 15 Wis save or Frightened (save again each turn; a minute at most).
actions.text: He lashes a creature within 60 feet with its own guilt: DC 15 Wisdom save or it is Frightened, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and freed automatically after a minute.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.trigger: He is hit by an attack roll while holding a weapon.
reactions.summary: Reaction: +3 AC against that one attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

options.name: Bloody Strike
options.summary: Moves up to half his Speed and makes one Sanguine Blade attack.

options.name: Castigate
options.summary: One creature within 60 ft: DC 15 Wis save or Frightened.

options.name: Overwhelm
options.summary: Casts Command; not again until the start of his next turn.

summary: A fallen crusader turned vampire, in two phases: half-transformed at the altar, then a bat-like horror under the blood moon with effigies of blood beside him.

phases.name: Beneath a Blood Moon
phases.summary: Viraxys laughs and a blood geyser throws everyone up into the cathedral: Renathyr's true form, three blood effigies, and Viraxys's lair actions.

lair_actions.name: Blood Torrent
lair_actions.summary: Up to three creatures within 30 ft: a DC 15 Dex save or knocked prone by a torrent of blood.
lair_actions.text: On Viraxys's count the blood in the room surges: up to three creatures within 30 feet of the pool make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or are thrown down.

lair_actions.name: Endless Minions
lair_actions.summary: If fewer than three effigies stand, another rises.
lair_actions.text: Viraxys wills another effigy up out of the blood, so long as fewer than three stand.

lair_actions.name: Viraxys Laughs
lair_actions.summary: A sultry, amused voice from the windows mocks the party.
